title: Capsule Filling with Custom 10x10 Racks
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required labware
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: 3 × custom 10 × 10 capsule racks in a custom Opentrons adapter, an Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tuberack set with a 4 × 6 insert holding 2 mL Eppendorf snap‑cap tubes, an Opentrons P1000‑single‑channel electronic pipette (GEN2), and an Opentrons 1000 µL tiprack.

steps.title: Dispense oil into capsules
steps.instruction: Using a single P1000 tip, transfer the specified volume of oil from a source container placed in the usual Opentrons trash‑bin location to up to 300 capsules seated in three 10 × 10 racks on the deck. Fill racks in order: top‑left, then bottom‑left, then bottom‑right. Within each rack, dispense down each column then across each row, keeping the same tip for the entire process.

steps.title: Enter fill parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol interface, input the number of capsules to fill, the transfer volume in µL, and select the P1000 pipette mount side.

steps.title: Download protocol
steps.instruction: Click the download button to save the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the three custom 10 × 10 capsule racks in the custom adapter, the 4‑in‑1 tuberack with 2 mL snap‑cap tubes, and the 1000 µL tiprack in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the labware, tiprack, and P1000‑GEN2 pipette; follow the on‑screen instructions or support articles for tip calibration.

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the capsule‑filling protocol.
